mails.subject: Verify your candidate account
mails.body: Welcome to Vanguard. Verify your candidate account here: https://vanguard.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/vanguard_external/activate/tok-4471

rule: A mail is accepted when any one of these holds: (a) its subject reads as an account-verification request ("Verify your candidate account", "Verify your email", "Please verify your e-mail address", "Activate your account", "Confirm your email address", and similar); (b) its body has a tenant link; (c) the sender's e-mail domain contains the tenant name or the company name (letters and digits only, case-insensitive; e.g. `vanguardhr.com` contains `vanguard`).
